method.contentSnapshot: llm-obsidian published content snapshot a4d2069946d8479e551c3bef6965b266dd08ce9a; 55 Markdown files
method.server: Astro preview server, localhost; production output built from identical content snapshot
method.browser: Playwright Chromium (headless, local isolated browser; not user Mac Chrome)
method.viewport: 390x844 CSS px; dark scheme; each run used a new browser context with theme=dark and a11y=0
method.repetitions: 5 cold contexts per page per variant; homepage and real Mermaid article /posts/ai-productivity-paradigm
method.measurements: DOMContentLoaded, load, browser Resource Timing script transfer/encoded/decoded bytes, island counts, overflow, page/console errors; click-to-theme-class response measured from click to html.dark removal. Article rows waited for all four rendered Mermaid SVGs.
method.limitations: Astro preview is local and does not model Cloudflare Brotli, reader network latency, or third-party request costs. Transfer size is browser-reported and can reflect cache accounting; decoded bytes are informational. DCL/load are localhost timings. This benchmark measures UI response from a successful click, not time-to-first-possible-interaction. No long-task series was collected.

baseline.browser: Chromium via Playwright, Astro preview on localhost

candidate.browser: Chromium via Playwright, Astro preview on localhost

builtHtmlBytes.method: Built HTML artifact sizes; gzip level 6 estimates are separate from browser script Resource Timing.
